meta.source: Yahoo Finance public chart / FRED / CNN index via MacroMicro or CNN / Binance
meta.priceBasis: Yahoo Adj Close; missing latest daily closes may use an observed completed regular-session 30m close after unit-factor/no-action checks, explicitly flagged as provisional. Intraday: Yahoo Close.
meta.dailyReconstructionPolicy: Only a complete regular session's observed 30m close; latest daily missing; unit prior adjustment factor; corporate-action dates excluded; provisional provenance retained.
meta.notice: Five-period weights inferred from public reference snapshots and rechecked on 2026-11-04; not an officially confirmed formula. Prices and runtime rankings are independently calculated from Yahoo. Long-term RS and historical ranks remain independent approximations.
